name: Velocette Venom / Thruxton / Viper
engine: 349 or 499 cc air-cooled high-cam OHV single, magneto
intro: Velocette's sporting singles. A high camshaft, a fiddly clutch to adjust and a magneto.

B: It runs a magneto. Check the points, the condenser and the slip ring before you blame the carb.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
